purpose: Freeze one primary, outcome-blind territorial hypothesis test after PRIMARY6 A5 and anti-leakage PASS and before opening any territorial activation evidence.

territorial_label_contract.CASE: An independently accepted physical territorial activation whose timing falls within the frozen event-date annotation window for a selected meteorological date.
territorial_label_contract.CONTROL: Independent documentary, sensor, or field evidence sufficiently covers the same frozen territorial unit and date annotation window and supports no physical activation.
territorial_label_contract.UNKNOWN: Activation timing is ambiguous, evidence conflicts, evidence coverage is insufficient, or a reliable positive/negative territorial outcome cannot be independently established.

primary_score.name: A3_COMPOSITE_SELECTED6
primary_score.per_feature_transform: Within each six-window stratum, rank the six frozen numeric A3 values ascending using deterministic average midranks for ties; convert rank r to percentile (r-1)/(n-1), n=6.
primary_score.composite: Arithmetic mean of the three within-stratum A3 percentiles.
primary_score.direction: Higher values represent greater frozen meteorological extremeness.
primary_score.missing_rule: If any required A3 slot is nonnumeric/null, the score is UNKNOWN for that window and that window cannot enter the inferential CASE/CONTROL set; it remains reported as UNKNOWN_SCORE without replacement or imputation.

primary_hypothesis.null: Within unit-season strata and among reliably labeled CASE/CONTROL windows, CASE assignment is not associated with larger A3_COMPOSITE_SELECTED6 than CONTROL assignment.
primary_hypothesis.alternative: Within unit-season strata and among reliably labeled CASE/CONTROL windows, CASE windows have larger A3_COMPOSITE_SELECTED6 values than CONTROL windows.

test.name: STRATIFIED_CONDITIONAL_CASE_SCORE_PERMUTATION
test.statistic: T = sum over informative strata of the sum of A3_COMPOSITE_SELECTED6 for windows labeled CASE.
test.conditioning: Condition on each informative stratum's observed number of CASE labels; permute CASE labels only among known CASE+CONTROL windows within the same stratum. UNKNOWN labels and UNKNOWN_SCORE windows are excluded from inference and never relabeled.
test.informative_stratum: At least one CASE and at least one CONTROL with numeric A3_COMPOSITE_SELECTED6.
test.monte_carlo_seed_derivation: Integer value of first 8 hexadecimal characters of the frozen A5 rows SHA-256 49c63921.
test.exact_p_value: number of conditional assignments with T_perm >= T_observed divided by total conditional assignments
test.monte_carlo_p_value: (1 + number of sampled assignments with T_perm >= T_observed) / (1 + B)
test.insufficient_evidence_terminal_rule: If there are zero informative strata or the conditional permutation space has no variation, return INCONCLUSIVE_OUTCOME_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT_FOR_PREREGISTERED_TEST. Do not change labels, thresholds, score, statistic, windows, or evidence rules to obtain a testable result.
